rationale: Test the economic compatibility of ATR horizon and entry-price cap with spot costs. No optimization to an 80% historical win rate.

data.reserved_unread_in_this_research: 2026 onward and all non-BTC/ETH assets; prior access elsewhere unknown

cost_assumptions.note: Published regular-user rate used as current decision scenario, not reconstructed historical fees. No BNB discount, maker fills or zero-fee promotions assumed. User venue/tier unconfirmed.

analysis: Report all seven runs, first-failure gates, asset attribution and yearly results without resets. Weekly-block bootstrap of daily mean return is descriptive and unadjusted for selection; no statistical promotion claim.
decision: No deployment or auto-promotion. Fewer than 500 trades, negative net expectancy, profit factor below 1.25, excessive drawdown or missing validation blocks promotion. At most identify a hypothesis for a separate locked test; do not retune after these results.
